episodes.186870: Periods of heavy rainfall due to a cold front led to flooding over portions of the State.
episodes.187512: A Wind Advisory was in effect for PR and the USVI from Tuesday afternoon to Thursday morning. This was due to the interaction of a surface high-pressure north of the area and a strong low-pressure system northeast of the Caribbean resulting in windy conditions over the local area. Sustained winds at 20 to 30 mph with frequent gusts around 35 to 45 mph were forecast.

events.narrative: Kuhio highway was closed at Hanalei bridge due to water over the road.
